panels.title: State head lag (blocks)
panels.description: pool_state_head minus the engine clock (pump clock). Healthy runs sit around -1 (pools sit one block behind the still-open current block). A freeze drives it MORE NEGATIVE as the clock advances on headers while pools stop applying - 0/positive is a restart/coverage artifact, not the freeze. See the pump liveness row for the real freeze signal.

panels.title: State head lag (state - clock)
panels.description: pool_state_head - engine clock over time. Healthy = -1 (a thin, stable line; it may dip to 0 when a block tombstones, i.e. a coverage gap, and jump positive for a few points after a restart/missed apply). The freeze is a *sustained climb more negative*, paired with rising apply-age and solve stalls - not a single level.

panels.title: Pipeline phase durations (p95): decode / apply / queue wait
Throughput: blocks / logs received / logs applied
Solver load: registered paths / solves / candidates
Liveness: drain queue depth + state head lag (freeze signature)
Liveness: header age + apply age (sit at 0; a freeze climbs them)
panels.description: Seconds since the newest newHeads header (feed liveness) and since the newest log applied to state (apply liveness). Healthy = both pinned at ~0. A feed stall lifts the header age; a drain freeze lifts the apply age while the header age stays low and head-lag goes negative. Red at >=30s is a genuine freeze window.

panels.title: Detached cycle: stragglers in flight + applied vs stale-dropped
Solver audit: clamps / verify blocks / publish state checks
Dispatch economics: mean gross / net (wei) + gas
Trace view: how to read the solve span tree

options.content:
## Jaeger drill-down - span tree (MQUKB6-T2 shape)

    degenbot.pump.block
    └─ degenbot.arb.solve              (T0 gate + wall clock + block.number)
       ├─ degenbot.arb.fanout            (paths.affected)
       ├─ degenbot.arb.resolve            (core-lock re-derive)
       ├─ degenbot.arb.lpt                (bin-pack)
       ├─ degenbot.arb.path xN  [DEBUG]   (path.id, path.us, path.sims, gate.us, path.profit)
       └─ degenbot.arb.merge              (streaming drain; merge.paths)

**Jaeger queries** (service `degenbot-bot`, host `host.docker.internal:16686`):

- Solve cycles: `operation=degenbot.arb.solve&limit=20&lookback=1h`
- Phase attribution: the `fanout` / `resolve` / `lpt` / `merge` children of a solve trace
- Per-path attribution: `operation=degenbot.arb.path` (needs `RUST_LOG=degenbot::solver=debug`)

The **Engine-Mutex hold** panel is the metric-level view of this tree: under
`DEGENBOT_DETACHED_SOLVES=1` the hold collapses from the in-cycle 5-20ms band to
enqueue cost (µs) while solves continue on the dedicated `degenbot-solve-tokio`
workers - a step change in that panel means the stance flipped, not a regression.
The **Detached cycle** panel is the sidecar-merge health (Q1a): in-flight is the
un-merged-straggler backpressure gauge (cap 8), and stale-dropped stragglers are
EXPECTED under pool churn - a sustained drop rate with zero applied means the
sidecar pipe is wedged.

panels.title: Pre-solve gap decomposition: delivery / burst / settle (p50/p95)

options.description: Decomposition of the block-to-solve gap BEFORE the solver engages (phases recorded at each settle point): header-to-first-log = WS delivery latency; log_burst = diffusion of the block logs across the feed (first-to-last); settle_wait = debounce/quiesce hold after the last log. Jaeger: the same values ride as span fields (header_to_first_log_us, log_burst_us, settle_wait_us) on degenbot.pump.block.

panels.title: Pre-solve gap means vs header-to-solved (mean dissolve)

options.description: Mean phase durations vs the total race number. delivery + burst + settle + solve should approximately equal header-to-solved; a residual means unbudgeted time (queue wait, registration, submit queue).
